description: Source code for MAP (Manifold Absolute Pressure) averaging and measurement in an engine control system, including ADC callback handling, trigger scheduling, and pressure calculation.

methods.name: startAveraging
methods.description: Initializes MAP averaging process, resets accumulators, and sets the averaging flag.

methods.name: mapAveragingAdcCallback
methods.description: Handles ADC samples, updates accumulators, and optionally logs data for sensor chart.

methods.name: endAveraging
methods.description: Finalizes MAP averaging, computes average pressure, updates buffer, and resets flags.

methods.name: applyMapMinBufferLength
methods.description: Configures the buffer length for MAP averaging and initializes buffer values.

methods.name: postMapState
methods.description: Outputs current MAP averaging state to Tuner Studio.

methods.name: refreshMapAveragingPreCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates start and duration angles for MAP averaging based on RPM.

methods.name: mapAveragingTriggerCallback
methods.description: Schedules start and end of MAP averaging windows based on shaft position triggers.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the current manifold absolute pressure, considering sensor configuration and averaging.

methods.name: initMapAveraging
methods.description: Initializes MAP averaging system, registers trigger listener, and sets up console commands.
